parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the protective cap of a USB flash drive, made of durable plastic. It is small and lightweight, designed to fit snugly over the USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached or reattached manually by sliding or pulling it off the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of plastic with an embedded metal USB connector. It houses the memory chip and electronic components.
parts.Functional_description: The base body contains the data storage and interface components, allowing the device to connect to computers and transfer data.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
